hero.title: Summer Courses in Finland
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: Finnish universities and summer schools offer different learning formats, including intensive classroom teaching, online learning, workshops, and cultural activities. Depending on the institution, students may earn **ECTS credits**, receive a course certificate, or gain practical knowledge in a specific subject.

faq.question: What are Summer Courses in Finland?
faq.answer: Summer courses are intensive 1 to 4-week academic programmes offered between June and August by Finnish universities, awarding official transferable ECTS credits (2–10 ECTS) in fields like AI, business, sustainability, and Finnish culture.

faq.question: Can Indian university students apply for Finnish summer schools?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral students enrolled in recognised universities can apply directly for English-taught summer courses across Finland.

faq.question: What is the typical cost of Summer Courses in Finland?
faq.answer: Course tuition ranges from €500 to €950 for intensive 2 to 3-week university programmes (approx ₹54,000 to ₹1.03 lakh). Open university modules cost approximately €15 to €45 per ECTS credit. Accommodation and living costs average €250 to €400 per week.

faq.question: Do Finnish summer courses grant transferable academic credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Finnish university summer schools provide an official University Transcript of Records awarding 2 to 10 ECTS credits compliant with the European Bologna framework, which can be transferred to your home university.

faq.question: When should I apply for Summer Courses in Finland?
faq.answer: Application deadlines differ by programme. For example, the University of Eastern Finland opens applications for its August 2027 Summer School in March 2027, while the Summer University of Jyväskylä opens registration for its 2027 Finnish course from October 2026. Always check official university portals for current deadlines.
